description: With the same test pack and only bbb:same_mix known, at a crafting table: a full placement shift-clicked makes one birch log and stops at the first recipe's oak log; clicks outside the grid and a second placement keep the placed recipe, a grid stack taken and put back or one more stick ends it; a grid filled by hand makes the oak log, and placing onto it the birch log; with doLimitedCrafting on a grid filled by hand makes nothing, a placement the birch log and nothing once one is taken; a full placement in the own window makes 64 oak logs; Circuit and both official servers give the same windows, logs and recipes (those unlocked at once compared as sets)
